description.value: The Bennett Craft Kitchen is a community-oriented pub in South Surrey blending traditional English pub warmth with modern culinary creativity. The menu features locally sourced ingredients across classic pub fare including burgers, fish and chips, beef dip, and tacos, alongside craft cocktails and beer. The venue hosts weekly live events and offers private event booking including fundraiser pub nights for local organizations.
